thread:
eva_support: FYI customer reported 403s after their IdP rotated certs this morning. Happening only for some users, others OK. Error from logs: "Recipient mismatch: expected https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs but got https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs/"

customer_jess: Confirmed — they rotated keys at 07:12 UTC; we started seeing errors at ~07:15. SAML response attached to ticket (saml-response.xml). Some IdPs will normalize the ACS without trailing slash, others include it.

samir_engineering: :eyes: that recipient mismatch is classic. Two quick checks: 1) does our metadata cached copy have the pre-rotate certificate or an ACS without trailing slash? 2) is there any proxy/nginx rewrite that strips/forces trailing slash?

leah_oncall: Ticket #SR-1429 created and linked: https://support.redwood.ai/t/SR-1429. I pulled the customer's metadata; it contains two <AssertionConsumerService> entries — one with trailing slash. They also have both old and new certs in the IdP metadata.

idp-bot: Automated check: customer metadata last fetched 2026-03-12T07:10:05Z, hash mismatch with posted metadata at 2026-03-12T07:12:00Z. Cache TTL for external IdP metadata is 6h by default.

samir_engineering: Ok that explains the window. Two remediation paths: A) force immediate metadata refresh for the customer (we have an admin endpoint), B) instruct the IdP to re-publish metadata with only current cert + normalized ACS. Recommend A while they update.

customer_jess: Can you refresh from your side? They can't change their IdP quickly (internal change control).

eva_support: I triggered a metadata refresh via admin API: POST /admin/idp/refresh?customer=acme-inc (response 202). Also purged metadata cache entry for acme-inc. Watching logs now.

ops_sre: Heads up — if we purge and they still send responses for the old/alternate ACS URL, we might need to accept both recipient variants briefly. That requires config change on the SAML verifier to allow either URL variant for that tenant. Eng approval needed.

eng_sso: Samir can you confirm feasibility to allow ACS variants per-tenant? Risk: opens recipient-check leniency which can be abused. If we do it, lock it to tenant and time-limited (30 min).

samir_engineering: I can add a per-tenant override to accept explicit extra recipients from the stored metadata (low-risk if tied to verified metadata). ETA ~2 hours for a hotfix and config flag. Steps: 1) validate metadata signatures; 2) append found ACS variants to allowed recipients for that tenant only; 3) log/alert if used.

leah_oncall: After purge, I see a spike of successful logins at 07:18; but a small subset still 403ing. Those 403s show recipient header with trailing slash encoded as %2F in RelayState redirect — could be the proxy or SSO plugin encoding.

customer_jess: The affected users are behind a federated proxy appliance (vendor: NetEdge). They said they change URL rewriting behavior during cert rollovers.

samir_engineering: OK let's do a two-part fix: 1) short-term: apply tenant override to accept both exact ACS and ACS with trailing slash (hotfix). 2) medium-term: add normalization logic in SAML verifier to compare normalized URLs (strip optional trailing slash, decode percent encoding) when metadata fingerprint matches. I'll push the hotfix now.

eva_support: Applying hotfix flag for acme-inc now (manual toggle).

idp-bot: Hotfix toggle enabled by eva_support at 2026-03-12T07:22:14Z.

leah_oncall: After hotfix enabled, affected users report success at 07:23. Monitoring for 15m.

eng_sso: Thanks. Samir, please open a follow-up PR for canonicalization and a unit test for percent-encoded trailing slash cases. Also note in release notes: tenant-level recipient overrides are temporary and visible in security audit.

samir_engineering: Will do. Patch branches: feature/saml-accept-acs-variants -> PR 4123. Tests included.

customer_jess: Appreciate the fast response. Can you also provide a recommended IdP metadata config to avoid this in future?

eva_support: Sent recommended metadata snippet to the customer and added best-practices to SR-1429: include only current certs, prefer single ACS entry (explicit URL without trailing slash), ensure IdP proxies preserve URL encoding on redirects, and set up an out-of-band rotation window with us.

ops_sre: Closing loop — I'll schedule a follow-up with infra to evaluate if our metadata TTL should be shorter for high-change tenants. For now SLA remediation satisfied. :white_check_mark:

eng_sso: Leave the toggle in place for 30 min, then revert after we confirm no more errors. Also tag security for a quick review of the tenant override implementation.

leah_oncall: Revert scheduled at 2026-03-12T07:55:00Z (30 min). Will update ticket after revert.

eva_support: Noting customer feedback and closing customer-facing update. Thanks team.
